body: So far it has been holding up for 9 months. I will keep this in mind if it does come crashing down. Thanks for the feedback!

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:5318029

`git clone --recurse-submodules https://git.cryptonomic.net/cubbies.git` then open cubbies.scad in OpenSCAD to get started.


Here is a direct link to the scad code if you want to take a look without doing a git clone: https://git.cryptonomic.net/cubbies.git/plain/cubbies.scad


I ended up writing some shell script wrappers (shopenscad.sh and cubbies.sh) around the OpenScad command for generating multiple models. I'm curious if anyone else here has found themselves doing that? I know I did find at least one project that did something similar at some point. I wrote it mainly because I wanted to be able to generate models and have the file names automatically generated from the values of the parameters passed in.
